bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are dealing with lingering fallout from their 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Packers, as head coach Ben Johnson remains noncommittal on his starting quarterback if Caleb Williams misses another game , with Williams working his way back from a hamstring injury. Adding to the uncertainty, the Bears' embarrassing loss to the Green Bay Packers is one thing, but now the team will have to hope the defensive injuries suffered in that game are not long-term.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions blew out the Arizona Cardinals 45-21 on Sunday, with Jared Goff and Jahmyr Gibbs combining for six touchdowns as Lions torch Cards . However, the win came with a tough blow heading into the bye week as wide receiver and returner Tom Kennedy suffered a torn MCL and is out for the season, according to NFL Network Insider Mike Garafolo .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers suffered a significant blow when tests confirmed Monday that defensive lineman Javon Hargrave tore his Achilles tendon during Sunday's 31-7 victory over the Chicago Bears, ending his 2026 season , prompting the team to scramble for depth as the Packers had former Patriots DT Isaiah Iton in for a workout and physical as Green Bay scans the market for DT help . Adding to the injury concerns, the Packers are not expecting star pass-rushing linebacker Micah Parsons to return to practice this week ahead of their matchup against the Dallas Cowboys .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings remain undefeated at 5-0 heading into their bye week after a 23-13 win over the Saints, with Murray completing 24 of 30 passes and throwing a spectacular touchdown pass to Justin Jefferson . During the bye, the team is bolstering its wide receiver depth, as Juju Smith-Schuster was the most prominent name to show up for a workout on Monday, joined by D'Wayne Eskridge and Dayton Wade , while also dealing with an injury to tight end T.J.
